blocks.text: Ecosystem mein jandar khane ke groups mein tarteeb diye jate hain jinhein trophic levels kehte hain.

items: Trophic level 1: sabz paude, algae aur photosynthetic bacteria, yaani primary producers.
Trophic level 2: primary consumers (sabzi khor) jo seedha producers khate hain, jaise keere aur khargosh.
Trophic level 3: secondary consumers (gosht khor) aur janwaron ke parasites jo sabzi khoron ko khate hain, jaise mendak aur saanp.
Trophic level 4: tertiary consumers, gosht khoron ko khane wale janwar, jaise bheriye aur baaz.
Decomposers aur detritivores, kitab ki misalon mein kekre, gidh aur gidar, alag level banate jo baqi sab par palta hai, detritus (murda galta maadda) aur fuzla kha kar.

blocks.alt: Chaar tasveerein upar tale, narangi teeron se jurin: trophic level 1, fern; level 2, tidda (grasshopper); level 3, chooha; level 4, uqaab. Suraj se peela teer level 1 tak. Har level se patle teer decomposers ke gulabi daire (khumbi, bacteria aur doosre jaraseem) tak jaate hain.

blocks.prompt: Khargosh kis trophic level par hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Trophic level 2: yeh primary consumer (sabzi khor) hai jo seedha producers khata hai.

items: Producers, primary, secondary, tertiary consumers; decomposers sab levels par palte.
